testo: ■ Your opponent can't put cards from their deck into their graveyard.
testo_jp: ■ 相手は自身の山札からカードを墓地に置くことはできない。

lato_b.testo: ■ Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. You may choose a nature creature that costs 5 or less from among them, show that creature to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Then put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.
lato_b.testo_jp: ■ 自分の山札の上から5枚を見る。その中から、自然のコスト5以下のクリーチャーを1体、相手に見せてから手札に加えてもよい。残りを好きな順序で自分の山札の一番下に置く。
